title: Nobody Programmed AI's Answers. It Learned Them Like This
description: AI assistants weren't programmed with answers. They learned. Here's how training works in three simple stages: learning from text, from examples, and from feedback. Follow for a new AI lesson every day. #shorts #ai #learnai #claude #howaiworks

scenes.narration: Nobody programmed AI with answers. It learned them. Here's how.
It starts with training data. A huge amount of text, from books, websites, and more.

visual.title: *Training data*
visual.subtitle: Huge amounts of text the model learns from

scenes.narration: Then it plays a guessing game. Hide the next word. Guess it. Check the answer. Adjust a tiny bit. Repeat, billions of times.
Now it can continue any text. But it isn't a helpful assistant yet.
So it's trained again. First on examples of good answers. Then with feedback on which answers are better.
Try it. Ask Claude to explain how it was trained, in three simple steps.

visual.title: Try this prompt
items: How were you trained? Explain in 3 simple steps.
First I learned patterns from lots of text. Then from examples of good answers. Then from feedback on better responses.
